patch_description: This approach replaces simple threshold rules with a multi-dimensional pressure scoring system. It computes separate pressure scores for latency trends, queue congestion, and size-based risk, then combines them using weighted sums. Key improvements: (1) Uses exponential weighting to emphasize recent observations, (2) Detects latency acceleration/deceleration trends, (3) Applies adaptive thresholds based on system state, (4) Uses multiplicative risk factors for compound conditions. The scoring system is more sensitive to emerging congestion patterns and should reduce false admits by catching deteriorating conditions earlier.
